items.quote: And she is a kickboxing champ, and you can see that.

items.claim: Spacic gave up double leg takedowns in her previous fights.
items.quote: Now, she was giving up double leg takedowns.

items.claim: Spacic struggled to cut off her opponent in the fight against Alves.
items.quote: I also noticed in her fight against Alves, she didn't cut her off at all.

items.claim: Luciano showed improvements in a short amount of time.
items.quote: really showed improvements in a short amount of time to turn that thing around.

items.claim: Spacic's takedown defense is weak and she gives up takedowns to poor wrestlers.
items.quote: I've seen her giving up takedowns to girls who are not good wrestlers.

items.claim: Luciano is well-rounded enough to both strike and take Spacic down.
items.quote: I think Luciano is wellrounded enough to strike with her and take her down here.
